intro h
split
· intro h'
  rw [Union_eq_iSup]
  exact (h' hc).symm
· rintro h' s ⟨x, y⟩ hxy
  contrapose! h'
  rintro s' ⟨t, u⟩ htu
  by_cases h1 : s' = s
  · rw [h1] at htu
    exact htu hxy
  · have h2 : s' ⊆ s ∨ s ⊆ s' := hc.2 s s'
    rcases h2 with h3 | h4
    · exact h' s' h3
    · exact h' s h4
